lines.en: I cross the snow, deep then shallow.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子分开，陷不下去。
lines.en: My hooves splay and don't sink.
I walk along the treeline.
My antlers thread the low branches.
I set one foot, then the next.
There's grass under the snow. I know.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方留着蹄印。
lines.en: My prints stay where I pass.
I lower my head and push the snow aside.

lines.zh: 我绕过一块结冰的石头。
lines.en: I skirt a frozen stone.

lines.zh: 我抬腿，蹄子在空中停了一下。
lines.en: I lift a leg and hold it a moment.
I make my way down the slope.

lines.zh: 我踩着雪前行，耳朵竖着。
lines.en: I walk through snow, ears pricked.
Snow clings to my antlers.
I cross the ice slowly.
I keep to the rock to avoid the wind.
I stand, steam from my nostrils.
I nose for grass under the snow.
The snowfield is quiet.
My antlers grew a little crooked.
Head low, I wait for the snow to ease.
I turn my flank to the wind.
I paw the ground twice.
I hear bells far off.

lines.zh: 我在这么冷的地方也能睡。
lines.en: I can sleep in cold like this.
These antlers stay on through winter.
I don't fear cold. I fear being chased.
I look up at that cloud.
My coat is thick, two layers.
You stand out on the snow.

lines.zh: 我这里没有你要的东西。
lines.en: I have nothing you want.
Your hand moved too suddenly.

lines.zh: 我的角分叉，像一棵小树。
lines.en: My antlers branch like a small tree.
Are you taking this path?

lines.zh: 你的气味，不像这片苔原上的。
lines.en: Your scent doesn't belong on this tundra.
You're dressed too lightly.
You stand, and I stay still.
The shadow in the snow is yours.
Back away slowly and I'll relax.

lines.zh: 我短促地叫了一声，蹄子发软。
lines.en: A short grunt escapes me; my hooves go weak.
My flank was grazed.
I shake and the snow falls off.
I limp away.
I can still run with this.
I lower my head and stay quiet.
Blood on the snow. Very red.
I should leave this slope.
Is there grass like this under the snow?

lines.zh: 我慢慢走过来，蹄子踩碎薄冰。
lines.en: I walk over slowly, hooves breaking thin ice.
I bring my nose closer.
Set it down. I'll find it.
I scrape at the snow.
Keep that hand where it is.
When I'm done, I'll look up.

lines.zh: 你要是一直喂，我就不走。
lines.en: Keep feeding and I won't leave.
I root through snow for lichen.
The snow wets my nose.
What's here tastes a bit salty.
You bump me; I turn my flank.
I back off and a hoof slips.
I don't like being crowded.

lines.zh: 你踩到雪里，我踩到石上。
lines.en: You sink in snow; I stand on stone.

lines.zh: 我被撞得偏了半步，又站住。
lines.en: Knocked half a step off, I plant my hooves.
You touched my antlers.
I walk away. I don't run.
The bump kicks up snow.
Don't stand behind me.
Another is on the snow slope.
Its coat is whiter than mine.
We forage side by side.
It walks ahead; I follow.

lines.zh: 风大的时候，我们挤在一起。
lines.en: In strong wind, we crowd together.
At dark we head downslope.
Tomorrow, the same route.

lines.zh: 这声低沉的咕哝，是给同伴的信号。
lines.en: This low grunt is a signal for my own kind.
I nudge it up with my lips.
This doesn't smell of grass.
I scrape it out with a hoof.
The pearl glints in the snow.
What I bury in the snow is something bright.

lines.zh: 鹿角上挂着雪，走一路掉一路。
lines.en: Snow hangs on my antlers and falls as I walk.
It's cold. I drop it.
My split hooves do not sink in the snow.
A sound up the slope.
I retreat upslope.
I heard it. Not the wind.
The snow keeps prints.
Let me take two steps first.
This isn't a herd scent.
I've fixed on that stone.
Legs taut, I am ready to bolt.
I run across the slope.
My hooves hold in the snow.
In the wind and snow I turn aside.
I don't call. Running is enough.
The snow deepens; it struggles.
I keep running for the trees.

lines.zh: 它的呼吸我听得很清楚。
lines.en: I hear its breathing clearly.
A little farther and I'm safe.
I strike with a forehoof.
That was only to drive it off.
I'm knocked back.
I try not to fight head-on.
I butt and run.
Its hand caught my antler.

lines.zh: 角向前一顶，雪沫四处飞。
lines.en: Antlers thrust forward, snow spray flying everywhere.

lines.zh: 我冲撞过去，蹄子砸得地面发闷。
lines.en: I charge in, hooves thudding dully on the ground.
I come from behind the snow slope.
One more shadow on the snowfield.
My antlers show over the treeline first.
The snow here isn't deep.
First I sniff the snow underfoot.
I kick away a layer of snow.
The herd isn't far.
There's grass to be found here.

lines.zh: 火卷过我的毛，焦味刺鼻。
lines.en: Fire sweeps my coat; the stench is sharp.
Icy water soaks in; I kick hard.
The blast throws snow and me.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进我的肩，绒都竖了。
lines.en: An arrow is in my shoulder and my coat bristles.
I'm too thin to stand steady.
